title: Audio Device Writer
text: Play to sound card, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Device output channels} sets nondefault channel mapping; {Driver}, {Device}, {Info} sets the view information about your audio output configuration, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate used by device to play audio, {Device bit depth} sets the data type used by device to perform digital-to-analog conversion 16-bit, {Use default channel mapping} sets the toggle channel mapping source and {Output number of samples underrun} sets the output port for number of samples underrun. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Driver
params.values: Driver used to access your audio device DirectSound (default) | ASIO | WASAPI

params.name: Device
params.values: Device used to play audio samples default audio device (default)

params.name: Info
params.values: View information about your audio output configuration button

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate used by device to play audio data 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Device bit depth
params.values: Data type used by device to perform digital-to-analog conversion 16-bit integer (default) | 8-bit integer | 24-bit integer | 32-bit float

params.name: Use default channel mapping
params.values: Toggle channel mapping source on (default) | off

params.name: Device output channels
params.values: Specify nondefault channel mapping [1:MaximumOutputChannels] (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Output number of samples underrun
params.values: Specify output port for number of samples underrun off (default) | on
